user.title: Set up Codex Bridge
user.description: Use the Home Assistant App for the private, recommended setup. External Bridge is an advanced legacy compatibility option.

app.title: Install or start the Codex Bridge App
app.description: Install the Codex Bridge App in Home Assistant Community Apps, start it, then retry. Home Assistant will discover its private endpoint and credentials automatically.

external.title: Connect an external legacy Bridge
external.description: Advanced compatibility setup. This accepts only a private legacy API v0 Bridge; use the Home Assistant App for current Codex features.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect the discovered Codex Bridge App
hassio_confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered {name}. Confirm to validate its private endpoint and add the Integration; retry if the App is temporarily unavailable.

error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach the Codex bridge service.
error.invalid_endpoint: Enter a valid private Bridge endpoint and token.
error.incompatible_api: This Bridge API is not compatible with the selected setup.
error.app_not_discovered: The App has not been discovered yet. Confirm that it is installed and running, then retry.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the bridge connection.

abort.already_configured: Codex Bridge already has a configured connection.
abort.invalid_discovery: The App discovery data was invalid.
abort.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach the App.
abort.incompatible_api: The App API is not compatible with this integration.
abort.unknown: The App could not be validated safely.
abort.host_bridge_required: Set up the normal Codex Bridge App first, then restart Codex Host Access.
abort.host_pairing_failed: Host Access could not pair. Update and restart Codex Bridge, then restart the Host Access App.
abort.host_paired: Host Access is paired. Review the warning in Codex Bridge to enable it; pairing alone grants no access.

init.title: Codex task settings
init.description: Choose task permissions and optionally expose a dedicated project to Assist. Assist runs in observe mode without web search or host access. People using voice have no verified HA identity; enable that separately only when everyone with access to Assist may hear answers from this project. Assist is unavailable while MCP is enabled in the App.

data.allow_unattended_task_actions: Allow unattended task actions from automations
data.assist_enabled: Enable Codex Bridge Assist conversation agent
data.assist_allow_voice_without_user: Allow voice requests without a signed-in HA user
data.assist_instructions: Assist instructions (plain text, up to 4,096 characters)

error.assist_project_required: Choose an active project before enabling Assist. Create a dedicated project in Codex Bridge if none is listed.
error.assist_model_unavailable: This model and reasoning combination is not advertised by the signed-in Codex account. Choose a supported combination or use the project defaults. Saved unavailable choices are not replaced automatically.
error.assist_instructions_invalid: Use plain-text Assist instructions of up to 4,096 characters. Templates are not evaluated.

abort.supervisor_only: Native web search settings are available only for the Home Assistant App connection.
abort.web_search_unavailable: Native web search is unavailable in the connected App. Update or restart the App, then try again.
